current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

past.employer_linkedin_description: We are Uber. The go-getters. The kind of people who are relentless about our mission to help people go anywhere and get anything and earn their way. past.employer_linkedin_description: Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

past.employer_linkedin_description: Indifi believes in helping small businesses grow by offering loans to those that have potential and intent. Most such businesses have little or no access to financing from traditional institutions such as banks or lack either collateral or finance data trail to access a loans.Indifi is a technology platform that gathers and analyses data of businesses from various sources and draws insights to judge their credit worthiness, their past and current performance in context of the industry they are operating in. past.employer_linkedin_description: Quikr, which now operates leading transaction marketplaces built on top of India’s largest classifieds platform, is India’s largest platform that is used by over 30 million unique users a month. It is present in 1200 cities in India and operates several large classifieds businesses across C2C, Cars, Education, Homes, Jobs, and Services. We are the only classifieds platform not just in India but globally to go in for verticalization. The change in strategy has helped us go deeper into our key verticals - QuikrC2C for goods, QuikrCars for cars and bikes, QuikrHomes for residential and commercial properties, QuikrJobs for blue/grey collar jobs and QuikrServices for daily and long term services need to offer a richer consumer experience.  The Quikr platform operates across desktop, laptop and mobile phones, and allows consumers as well as small businesses to sell, buy, rent and find things across its multiple categories with great ease. Flexibility has always been key to our success and the essence of this is captured by our motto: ‘Aasaan Hai Badalna’ (Change is Easy).  We have always strived to understand and meet the needs of Indian consumers with consumer insights forming the backbone of everything we do. We introduced a series of innovations such as Quikr Nxt, Maximum Sales Price (MSP) calculator, Missed call, Car inspection report, Vernacular Support and the QuikrScanner app to help lift the consumer experience to a whole new level and be a game-changer for the industry. In yet another pioneering move, we have also brought the convenience of ecommerce for pre-owned goods with Quikr Doorstep. Founded by Pranay Chulet in 2008, our investors include Warburg Pincus, Kinnevik, Tiger Global Management, Matrix Partners India, Norwest Venture Partners, Nokia Growth Partners, Steadview Capital, Omidyar Network, Ebay Inc.

Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

basic_profile.name: Nandan Sharma
basic_profile.headline: Senior Vice President at Zupee
basic_profile.summary:
I’m passionate about building businesses that solve meaningful problems and scale with purpose. Over the years, I’ve worked across diverse leadership roles — from launching new business lines to driving strategic growth initiatives and leading cross-functional teams in dynamic, high-growth environments.

What excites me is the challenge of transforming ideas into outcomes. Whether it’s navigating market uncertainty, crafting growth strategies, or building teams that move fast and think big — I believe in staying hands-on, data-informed, and people-first.

Recently, I enhanced my leadership toolkit through an Executive Education program at Kellogg School of Management, where I engaged with global leaders on strategy, innovation, and leading organizational change.

At my core, I’m driven by curiosity and a bias for action. I enjoy working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership — building not just companies, but cultures that endure.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

past.employee_description:
Scaled Zoto from the start of 1.5 million registered users in just 12 months.

Brand marketing: Zoto suffered from lack of trust and product understanding at user level. 
A series of controlled experiments using a mix of highly targeted media helped moved key metrics phenomenally. Brand searches grew by 44%, activation rate improved by 15%, Organic user grew by 18% and CPI for paid went down by 9%. 

Performance marketing: Despite a low Cost per install from paid channels like FB and Google, only 9% of the paid users were actually transacting, thus making the cost per acquiring a new transacting user from paid channels not scalable. Instead of focusing on a top funnel approach, I focused on improving the onboarding rate, activation rate and focused on channels that got in quality users. Reduced cost of transacting acquisitions from paid by 25% (YOY);  

Revenue growth: Increased monthly transacting users by 65% (YOY); Achieved this by breaking the problem statement into three parts (Acquisition, Revival & Retention) and conducting multiple experiments focused on each. Increased order volumes by 200% (YOY); achieved this by modeling a segmented user approach focused on increasing ARPU. Improved retention by 52% (YOY); achieved this by quality acquisitions and understanding new user data to create programs that reduced churn at early stage.

Viral growth: Conducted multiple experiments around referral, influencer & PR to build a viral growth engine central to the product. Referral contributed to 50% of the new user growth with the highest activation rate.  News jacking PR delivered 12X media value and even delivered on growth. 


Marketing burn: Reduced burn as a % of GMV by 60% (YOY); achieved this with multiple experiments including segmented offers, gamification & effective communication in app and on CRM channels. Improved activation rate by 35% (YOY); Worked on improving the conversion funnel post on-boarding.

OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and Southeast Asia.OYO was founded by 27-year-old Ritesh Agarwal, the first Asian resident to be accepted to the Thiel Fellowship (started by Paypal founder Peter Thiel).OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points. OYO’s comprehensive, full-stack technology suite integrates more than 40 products and services across digital sign-up and onboarding, revenue management, daily business management and D2C stacks into two flagship patron applications, Co-OYO and OYO OS. OYO customers can book storefronts through OYO’s own D2C channels and through indirect channels with third-party OTAs. The OYO App offers a variety of digital tools to guide customers throughout their journey, including discovery, seamless booking, pre-stay assistance, cancellations, digital check-ins as well as in-stay and post-stay services. With over 100 mn downloads, the OYO App was the 3rd most downloaded travel app in 2020. OYO Wizard, OYO’s loyalty program, has 9.2 million members and is the second largest loyalty program run by a travel or food brand in India, by subscriber base.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

basic_profile.name: Rajnish Kumar
basic_profile.headline: Author of Made in Fire 🔥 | Co-founder & Group Co-CEO, ixigo | Building AI-native products, growth engines, teams and companies
basic_profile.summary: I have spent nearly two decades building ixigo. Made in Fire is the book I wish someone had handed me when we started.It is not a story about everything going right.It is about what building actually feels like from the inside: surviving the 2008 financial crisis, watching bookings fall to zero during COVID, finding true believers, building a culture that survives pressure, obsessing over users, scaling without losing your soul, and constantly reinventing yourself as technology changes.I co-founded ixigo in 2007 with a simple ambition: use technology to make travel better for millions of Indians. That journey has taken us through multiple near-death experiences, pivots, acquisitions, two IPO attempts, a public listing, and now another fundamental reinvention around AI.Along the way, I became increasingly interested in a larger question:Why do some teams keep building, innovating and surviving while others stop evolving?Made in Fire is my attempt to answer that question through the lessons we learnt the hard way.I write and speak about:• Building enduring startup cultures• Product and customer obsession• Growth and distribution• Finding and developing exceptional people• Full-stack thinking and high-agency teams• Innovation and reinvention• AI-native companies and the future of work• Founder resilience, health and longevityMade in Fire: A Playbook for Builders, Believers and Future Founders is published by Penguin Business.🔥 madeinfire.co

Made in Fire is the book I wish someone had handed me when we started.It is not a story about everything going right.It is about what building actually feels like from the inside: surviving the 2008 financial crisis, watching bookings fall to zero during COVID, finding true believers, building a culture that survives pressure, obsessing over users, scaling without losing your soul, and constantly reinventing yourself as technology changes.I co-founded ixigo in 2007 with a simple ambition: use technology to make travel better for millions of Indians. That journey has taken us through multiple near-death experiences, pivots, acquisitions, two IPO attempts, a public listing, and now another fundamental reinvention around AI.Along the way, I became increasingly interested in a larger question:Why do some teams keep building, innovating and surviving while others stop evolving?Made in Fire is my attempt to answer that question through the lessons we learnt the hard way.I write and speak about:• Building enduring startup cultures• Product and customer obsession• Growth and distribution• Finding and developing exceptional people• Full-stack thinking and high-agency teams• Innovation and reinvention• AI-native companies and the future of work• Founder resilience, health and longevityMade in Fire: A Playbook for Builders, Believers and Future Founders is published by Penguin Business.🔥 madeinfire.co

past.employer_linkedin_description: Doubtnut leverages technology to make education accessible for all.We have created an App using which students can ask study questions in Math by clicking the picture of the problem or concept. Subject matter experts then create a Khan Academy style video to answer each doubt. Why video, because in our experience as teacher/educator we have seen students not being able to understand text solutions. In fact around 30% of the questions asked on doubtnut so far are actually solved examples from textbooks. The reason for this could be twofold: i. Text solutions are usually the most optimal solution, which might not be the most intuitive one ii. Also, the solutions are optimized for printing hence not all logic and thoughts behind the problem solving are written. With video solution we try not only to find the answer but also make students aware of the problem solving approach employed by the expert. This will lead to deeper understanding of the concept. As of today the low teacher to student ratio and unavailability of good teachers are the biggest hurdles to effective doubt resolution. Doubtnut solves for it by reusing content that has already been created to resolve the doubts, because more students find the same question tough. Hence, a huge number of doubts can be resolved with limited number of teachers. Also the time required to create a video of ‘n’ minutes is ‘n+2’ minutes, which means the marginal cost is minimal, and will reduce to zero over time as we will have videos for most types of questions. Currently, we are working on developing technology to automate answering of questions asked previously using image recognition and Natural Language Processing.

basic_profile.current_title: VP | Growth @ Abhibus (Bus Vertical of ixigo)
basic_profile.summary:
If you ask me what's the one big innovation by humankind, I would give it to the "internet" without a second thought! 

In a world where the internet has fueled innovation and made technology easily accessible to remote places of the world, Marketing is no longer about promoting product attributes, but making an emotional connection with the consumer/customer

I am a marketer building brands/businesses on three pillars, One - Emotional Connect, Two - Consumer Insights & Three - Purpose! I believe that any brand can become successful if laid on these pillars. These three pillars have laid the foundation my career, helping me win multiple awards at all the places I had worked and also helped me in solving three business cases in HUL LIME Season 9, ending up as National Runners up

I am currently working as a Marketing Manager in Softlines Private Brands at Amazon managing performance marketing, brand presentation & traffic planning for the channels. I plan, phase, and manage a budget of around 25 Cr in ad spend and lead the data analysis and reporting while diving deep to bring in improvements. I work customer backward by showcasing the right product to the right customer at right time thereby improving the conversions

Prior to Amazon, I was working with udaan, which gave me a new perspective on how exciting work can be especially with a lot of customer problem statements to solve. It always puts me in a bootstrapping mode which enables me to think about the problem from a whole new perspective by understanding the customers, knowing their pain points, and gaining insights from the markets. I worked on category marketing which involved merchandising, improving traffic health (repeats, loyalty, AOV, Wallet share), mega-event planning & execution, digital marketing, customer engagement, growth hacking for new D2C brands, and trade promotions for multiple brands including launching a private label

Prior to that, I was working with Johnson & Johnson managing three brands in the skincare portfolio including their P&L, communication, and customer connect

Prior to my MBA, I was working as an executive in the Innovation Team of Titan Company Ltd. where I was part of a team that tries to bring in the "WOW" factor in the customer experience!

The one thing that excites me the most is innovation. I strongly believe that Innovation could be or rather should be in everything we do and there definitely is abundant scope. We just need to ask the right questions to gain the critical insight that fuels innovation!

past.employee_description:
•	Studied the weaver community of Pochampally and the distribution channel of weaved sarees and margins at each stage
•	Conducted a thorough research on weaver wages and suggested the government to implement the minimum wage policy


Conducted primary research to collect details on how the wage is structured for the weavers of Pochampally district, Telangana. Currently the weavers in the area are earning an average of Rs.168/day which is lot lower than the government minimum wage level of Rs.250 a day. 
Conducted an in-depth analysis of the distribution channels and the margin associated at each level of the handloom sarees of Pochampally.  Suggested changes in the distribution channels to optimize the profit to the weavers who are currently being exploited. 
A handloom saree which is being sold in a Large Format Store for Rs.15000, fetches a wage of Rs. 1000 to the weaver. The middlemen enjoy the large margins. Instead, with better marketing and sales strategies, the middlemen negotiation power can be largely curbed and the weavers can enjoy higher wage rates. Suggested ways to use digital marketing to widen the reach and to touch newer unexplored market from across the globe

basic_profile.summary: I am a Technology Lead with 11+ years of experience designing, architecting, and scaling high-performance backend systems across travel, airlines, enterprise SaaS, and telecom domains. basic_profile.name: Prashant Gupta
basic_profile.headline: Principal Engineer, AI Products @ ixigo | Generative AI, LLM & Multi-Agent Systems | Conversational & Voice AI | Python, Node.js, Distributed Systems
basic_profile.summary: Principal Engineer building production AI systems at ixigo, one of India's largest travel platforms. Ten years in backend engineering; since 2024, entirely on LLM-powered voice and agentic products.I designed the multi-agent orchestration layer that ixigo's AI products run on — agent routing, tool calling against live booking systems, short- and long-term memory, and deterministic fallback when a model or downstream service degrades. It began as the backbone of our voice-calling platform and is now reused across the company's agentic products.What I've shipped:• TARA — in-app voice-to-voice assistant. Full-duplex streaming speech with interruption handling, so users can talk over the agent and it recovers mid-turn. The agent navigates the app alongside the user and reaches search, booking, check-in and PNR by calling tools under that user's own authenticated session, so it can only ever act within their entitlements. ~40,000 conversations a day.• AI voice-calling platform. Replaced ixigo's legacy IVR and now carries most inbound and outbound call volume autonomously, with short- and long-term caller memory. Complex intents such as cancellations transfer to a human agent live, on the same call, with context carried across.• Evaluation platform. Built the harness our AI products ship against: replay of production conversations scored on 10+ parameters including agent task completion and ASR correctness, run as a release gate rather than a dashboard.• Echo — conversation intelligence. Model-graded scoring across CX and AI conversations, calibrated against human-rated samples until agreement held and then run without the human layer. Categorises user issues and routes product feedback automatically.• PLAN — AI itinerary generation bringing non-transactional users onto the platform.Before AI, I led ixigo's flights backend (2019–2024): a monolith-to-microservices migration with a team of 11, and a probabilistic booking-distribution service that doubled margin on routed flight bookings.I give technical direction to 10+ engineers and work with product and business leadership on what gets built. Earlier: farmer-outreach and crop-insurance platforms at FarmGuide, UPI payments at Abyeti, and an open-source contribution to Stack Overflow's Stacks Editor.Gurugram · prashant.gupta1194@gmail.com

Moreover, our expertise lies into handling and transforming data into business opportunities, risk analysis and relevant advisories for stakeholders across the supply chain. past.employee_description:
Excellent Incident management, troubleshooting and problem solving skills. 
o	Perform the management of both reactive root-cause analysis (RCA) and proactive trend analysis.
o	Analysis and reporting of incident trend data to identify and eliminate root causes.
o	Keep track of operational metrics:  Incident Count, Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), Time to Acknowledgement / Time to Response, Escalations.
o	ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana) : all logs aggregated into one place, no need to log into different servers to debug.
o	Configuration/Deployment Management tools: Ansible, Puppet, Glu
o	CI/CB: Git, Gerrit, Maven, Ant, Jenkins
o	Automated website functional sanities with Jenkins, Selenium and python. 
o	Real time monitoring with StatsD, Graphite, Cubism, JMXTrans, Grafana.
o	Infra/User Experience Monitoring  with Zabbix, Nagios, Zenoss, KaaE, PingDom.
o	WebPageTest API integration with Jenkins to perform seamless site performance tests.
o	Deployed custom production tools using Shell, Python and CGI scripting.
• Build systems that tolerate failure - User experience is not meaningfully degraded when things fail.
• Create Proof of Concept/Prototypes in order to evaluate new technologies, proactively contribute to infrastructure platform.
• Traffic management: BIG-IP F5 LTM/GTM load balancing/HA. Split traffic between DC based on different routing policies. Geo-Location based traffic management using DNS policies, F5 iRule to split user/bot traffic.
• AWS Services : EC2, ELB, route 53, CloudFront CDN, S3, RDS, VPC, Security group, IAM, Cloud Watch
• Manage different traffic sources : SEM, SEO, Direct NAV, Affiliate, Banners
• Capacity planning: Assess application performance & determining hardware capacity requirements.
• Lead daily operation & Incident review meeting.
• Analyze business metrics (Conv/RPV) during every production deployment.
• Managing team of 20+ skilled NOC, SRE and DevOps.

basic_profile.name: Rajnish Kumar
basic_profile.headline: Author of Made in Fire 🔥 | Co-founder & Group Co-CEO, ixigo | Building AI-native products, growth engines, teams and companies
basic_profile.summary: I have spent nearly two decades building ixigo. Made in Fire is the book I wish someone had handed me when we started.It is not a story about everything going right.It is about what building actually feels like from the inside: surviving the 2008 financial crisis, watching bookings fall to zero during COVID, finding true believers, building a culture that survives pressure, obsessing over users, scaling without losing your soul, and constantly reinventing yourself as technology changes.I co-founded ixigo in 2007 with a simple ambition: use technology to make travel better for millions of Indians. That journey has taken us through multiple near-death experiences, pivots, acquisitions, two IPO attempts, a public listing, and now another fundamental reinvention around AI.Along the way, I became increasingly interested in a larger question:Why do some teams keep building, innovating and surviving while others stop evolving?Made in Fire is my attempt to answer that question through the lessons we learnt the hard way.I write and speak about:• Building enduring startup cultures• Product and customer obsession• Growth and distribution• Finding and developing exceptional people• Full-stack thinking and high-agency teams• Innovation and reinvention• AI-native companies and the future of work• Founder resilience, health and longevityMade in Fire: A Playbook for Builders, Believers and Future Founders is published by Penguin Business.🔥 madeinfire.co

Made in Fire is the book I wish someone had handed me when we started.It is not a story about everything going right.It is about what building actually feels like from the inside: surviving the 2008 financial crisis, watching bookings fall to zero during COVID, finding true believers, building a culture that survives pressure, obsessing over users, scaling without losing your soul, and constantly reinventing yourself as technology changes.I co-founded ixigo in 2007 with a simple ambition: use technology to make travel better for millions of Indians. That journey has taken us through multiple near-death experiences, pivots, acquisitions, two IPO attempts, a public listing, and now another fundamental reinvention around AI.Along the way, I became increasingly interested in a larger question:Why do some teams keep building, innovating and surviving while others stop evolving?Made in Fire is my attempt to answer that question through the lessons we learnt the hard way.I write and speak about:• Building enduring startup cultures• Product and customer obsession• Growth and distribution• Finding and developing exceptional people• Full-stack thinking and high-agency teams• Innovation and reinvention• AI-native companies and the future of work• Founder resilience, health and longevityMade in Fire: A Playbook for Builders, Believers and Future Founders is published by Penguin Business.🔥 madeinfire.co

We also welcome people of diverse skill sets, backgrounds and preferences to join us in this quest to move the world forward.

Founded in 2013, AgroStar is one of India’s foremost AgTech start-ups, working on the mission of Helping Farmers Win. AgroStar is an end-to-end solutions provider that is solving three major problems of farmers - limited access to good quality agri inputs, a gap in knowledge and information about scientific farming practices, and a lack of access to the best markets to sell their produce. Today, AgroStar serves millions of farmers across seven Indian states via an omnichannel approach. We have built India’s largest Agri Advisory Center, a highly engaged digital farmer network on the AgroStar app, with over 7.5 million users and a retail network of 7000+ stores (rapidly expanding). Through the acquisition of INI Farms, a leader in pomegranate, banana and fresh cuts exports from India, AgroStar is helping farmers sell their produce to some of the largest retail chains spread across 25+ countries in the world. Thus, building a full-stack model, solving for farmers’ problems end to end. Our platform, powered by data and technology, helps us to solve the problems faced by farmers at scale, thereby driving us closer to our mission of Helping Farmers Win.

current.employer_linkedin_description: By 2050 world food production has to be 2.5 times current levels while dealing with rapid loss of agricultural land to urbanization, dramatic changes in climate, deep impact of cancer causing chemicals as well as changing food habits. If there is one individual who is dealing with these massive problems on a daily basis, problems which even the most resourceful and powerful people, organizations and governments are grappling with, it is the farmer. And to think that our food security and by extension the survival of the species is dependent on the farmer working around these challenges without help, can easily demonstrate the magnitude of the problems staring at us., , FarmBee is at the forefront of solving this through the use of digital technology - making world class, data driven precision agriculture solutions available to farmers at a fraction of the cost., , We believe that problems of the magnitude that can impact hundreds of millions, require really smart people solving it. Talk to any of our people and you can feel the passion, creativity and optimism for building solutions on behalf of farmers and the agri ecosystem. We also welcome people of diverse skill sets, backgrounds and preferences to join us in this quest to move the world forward.

Founded in 2013, AgroStar is one of India’s foremost AgTech start-ups, working on the mission of Helping Farmers Win. AgroStar is an end-to-end solutions provider that is solving three major problems of farmers - limited access to good quality agri inputs, a gap in knowledge and information about scientific farming practices, and a lack of access to the best markets to sell their produce. Today, AgroStar serves millions of farmers across seven Indian states via an omnichannel approach. We have built India’s largest Agri Advisory Center, a highly engaged digital farmer network on the AgroStar app, with over 7.5 million users and a retail network of 7000+ stores (rapidly expanding). Through the acquisition of INI Farms, a leader in pomegranate, banana and fresh cuts exports from India, AgroStar is helping farmers sell their produce to some of the largest retail chains spread across 25+ countries in the world. Thus, building a full-stack model, solving for farmers’ problems end to end. Our platform, powered by data and technology, helps us to solve the problems faced by farmers at scale, thereby driving us closer to our mission of Helping Farmers Win.

bwin ist eine der bekanntesten Marken im globalen iGaming – mit Fokus auf Sportwetten, Casino und Poker. Seit über 25 Jahren sind wir Teil der Entertainment-Welt. Heute gehören wir zur Entain Group, einem der weltweit führenden Sportwetten- und iGaming-Anbieter. Gegründet in Wien, gewachsen in Europa, zu Hause in der Welt: Unsere Geschichte begann mit einer mutigen Idee – Sportwetten in die digitale Welt zu bringen. Heute sind wir eine digitale Entertainment-Marke, die Millionen Fans auf der ganzen Welt begeistert. Über unsere bwin App, Website und Plattformen liefern wir täglich Spannung, Spielgefühl und neue Features – schnell, sicher und intuitiv.Was uns antreibt? Das Spiel weiterzudenken. Wir entwickeln smarte Produkte, die Nutzer begeistern – mit Technologie, die Maßstäbe setzt, Features, die den Unterschied machen, und einem klaren Ziel: die Zukunft des iGaming aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei nehmen wir unsere Verantwortung ernst. Spielerschutz ist für uns kein Feature, sondern Standard. Wir investieren gezielt in Prävention, Transparenz und Kontrolle – und arbeiten kontinuierlich daran, sichere, faire und verantwortungsvolle Spielumgebungen zu schaffen. CSR ist für uns kein Buzzword, sondern Teil unserer Haltung als Marke und Arbeitgeber.Unsere Stärke? Ein internationales Team mit Know-how, Leidenschaft und Teamgeist. Über 20 Nationen. Eine Vision. Und ein Umfeld, in dem neue Ideen willkommen sind. Mit internen Tech Talks, Top-E-Learnings und Events wie Thirstdays oder Action Days schaffen wir Raum für Entwicklung, Austausch und echte Team-Momente. Wir glauben: Die besten Produkte entstehen da, wo Leidenschaft, Können und Teamgeist aufeinandertreffen.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Dash101 is a full stack ecommerce platform which allows individuals or organizations to either launch and manage an online business. Dash101 offers a free online shop website, industry leading logistics SaaS solutions, online payment integrations and marketing and promotion tools.Individuals like merchants, traders, social media enthusiasts and entrepreneurs can create their own online store with an integrated logistics solution, custom themes, catalogue manager and many advanced with one mobile app. Dash101 does not require coding, or subscription setup fees; and enables shipping all over India with cash on delivery (COD). Dash101 also enables scalability with online payment gateway integration in partnership with PayU; and bundles marketing and promotion services to grow one’s online presence quickly. For organizations and ecommerce entrepreneurs, who have already launched their ecommerce business; Dash101 offers cutting edge SaaS solutions to improve their logistics and deliveries; with advanced features like AI / ML powered NDR Management, easy integration with Shopify and WooCommerce. Dash101 Logistics allows ecommerce businesses to improve their profitability by reducing RTOs, improve customer experience with our Shipping Partner Recommendation Engine (SPRe), and increases their reach by servicing 27,000+ pincodes in India in partnership with 8+ courier partners like FedEx, BlueDart, XpressBees, Ecom Express and many more...Helping you win at business!
current.employee_description:
Dash101 is a full-stack ecommerce platform which allows individuals or organizations to either launch an online business or scale it with industry-leading logistics SaaS solutions.

current.employee_description:
Shop101 is India’s leading social commerce platform which enables entrepreneurs to sell online as well as on WhatsApp, Facebook & Instagram with zero investment by providing an online store in less than 2 minutes. Established merchants, as well as budding entrepreneurs including housewives, college students & young graduates, can put up their own products or resell from an extensive range of products available on the widely trusted Shop101 Supply platform. 

The Shop101 mobile app has enabled lakhs of sellers across India to sell online seamlessly within minutes by providing end to end order processing, inventory management, pan-India logistics (including cash on delivery), payment support, and a wide-range of supply. While there are about 50 - 60 million merchants in India, very few technologies and products have been built keeping in mind the small merchants.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Oracle is a global leader in AI, delivering the cloud infrastructure, data, and applications that organizations across the world trust to successfully achieve business outcomes at scale.Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) provides fast, flexible, scalable AI infrastructure. This enables organizations to operationalize AI without compromising data security or control. Oracle Applications embed AI directly into business workflows and industry processes to ensure AI is delivered in context, where work happens. They include the only applications suite that brings AI to every aspect of a business, with AI-powered ERP, HCM, and CX applications, and the Oracle Health Suite which provides applications for managing the entire healthcare ecosystem. Oracle also provides industry-specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries and NetSuite, the world’s first cloud computing company.  This LinkedIn page serves as Oracle’s official global company page.

basic_profile.name: Shivam Gupta
basic_profile.headline: Founder & CEO, LLUMO AI & MatSci AI • Angel Investor • Tech Entrepreneur • IIT Roorkee
basic_profile.summary: Shivam has successfully founded LLUMO AI (llumo.ai), Instaminutes (instaminutes.com), and a profitable venture MatSci AI (matsci.ai). Backed by top VCs like India Quotient, Sense AI, AumVC, and angels based out of the US, LLUMO AI helps AI teams to optimize the cost and quality of their LLM-powered AI products; potentially saving 80% cost by compressing prompts, and helping them to visualize 360-degree LLM performance in real-time.  Shivam leads AI product management and end-to-end operations at LLUMO AI. At Instaminutes, he led the team in changing how people took meeting notes. Instaminutes removes all the hassle of taking notes during the meeting and generates summarized meeting notes with one click. It's 10 times shorter than transcriptions and saves 90% of the time and effort. He scaled Instaminutes to $200k in ARR in just 1 year. He loves to network with business professionals and talk about how AI can help to make people's lives easier and more affordable.  Want to know more, please connect with him on LinkedIn.

past.employee_description:
I am the software engineering team lead in Alexa Speech Recognition (ASR) Cloud team in Amazon. ASR Cloud team owns Tier-1 services used for speech recognition for all Alexa. Currently leading a team of 10+ engineers for the improvement of speech recognition for Alexa customers to increase adoption of Alexa world-wide. As an engineering team lead I wear multiple hats time to time - from being a developer, a code/design reviewer, a mentor/guide, a SRE to promote operational excellence, on-call for the front line support of a Tier-1 service, an inventor to continuously evolve ASR's architecture, to a planner for current as well as future projects. My key contribution till date are:
 * Simplified ASR Cloud services architecture by introducing cell based architecture to develop a low maintenance cost solution to manage fleets for audio processing services containing 10,000+ hosts.
 * Introduced ability to conduct large scale A/B testing involving millions of customers for ASR ML model releases which provided much needed visibility on the customer facing metrics.
 * Introduced uniform audio delivery latency metrics to triage/debug and gaining insight in delays due to complex audio delivery across entire Alexa stack.
 * Designed and developed ML model release automation framework to safely release 100s of ML models per month across multiple audio processing tier-1 services in ASR org.
 * Designed and developed false traffic suppression service for Alexa to safe guard Alexa from media induced triggers from millions of devices waking up simultaneously due to commercials.

I was part of Catalog Metrics team in Amazon. Catalog Metrics team is part of ASCS (Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems) organization. My projects include, a pipeline for publishing catalog metrics, a platform to generate catalog metrics and a user’s dashboard. Internal teams at Amazon use metrics publishing pipeline to publish metrics generated by them. User’s dashboard is used by leaders and category managers in Amazon world-wide. Category managers and leaders use this dashboard to visualize metrics related to their part of the catalog. It helps them in taking business-critical decision for improving and expanding Amazon’s catalog. Platform for generating metrics can be used to generate important metrics from catalog activity feeds of various teams at Amazon. I was lead engineer on the projects and responsible for all deliverable from architecture, development and deployment.

past.employee_description:
I am the software engineering team lead in Alexa Speech Recognition (ASR) Cloud team in Amazon. ASR Cloud team owns Tier-1 services used for speech recognition for all Alexa. Currently leading a team of 10+ engineers for the improvement of speech recognition for Alexa customers to increase adoption of Alexa world-wide. As an engineering team lead I wear multiple hats time to time - from being a developer, a code/design reviewer, a mentor/guide, a SRE to promote operational excellence, on-call for the front line support of a Tier-1 service, an inventor to continuously evolve ASR's architecture, to a planner for current as well as future projects. My key contribution till date are:
 * Simplified ASR Cloud services architecture by introducing cell based architecture to develop a low maintenance cost solution to manage fleets for audio processing services containing 10,000+ hosts.
 * Introduced ability to conduct large scale A/B testing involving millions of customers for ASR ML model releases which provided much needed visibility on the customer facing metrics.
 * Introduced uniform audio delivery latency metrics to triage/debug and gaining insight in delays due to complex audio delivery across entire Alexa stack.
 * Designed and developed ML model release automation framework to safely release 100s of ML models per month across multiple audio processing tier-1 services in ASR org.
 * Designed and developed false traffic suppression service for Alexa to safe guard Alexa from media induced triggers from millions of devices waking up simultaneously due to commercials.

I was part of Catalog Metrics team in Amazon. Catalog Metrics team is part of ASCS (Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems) organization. My projects include, a pipeline for publishing catalog metrics, a platform to generate catalog metrics and a user’s dashboard. Internal teams at Amazon use metrics publishing pipeline to publish metrics generated by them. User’s dashboard is used by leaders and category managers in Amazon world-wide. Category managers and leaders use this dashboard to visualize metrics related to their part of the catalog. It helps them in taking business-critical decision for improving and expanding Amazon’s catalog. Platform for generating metrics can be used to generate important metrics from catalog activity feeds of various teams at Amazon. I was lead engineer on the projects and responsible for all deliverable from architecture, development and deployment.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The D. E. Shaw group is trusted by investors across the world to seek an optimal balance of risk and reward. We launched in 1989 as a pioneer in systematic investing and have built on that foundation to develop formidable expertise in fundamental analysis and discretionary investing. We use a combination of quantitative tools and human-driven insights to uncover independent, hard-to-find sources of return across global public and private markets.Founded in 1988 over a small bookstore in downtown New York City, the D. E. Shaw group began with six employees and $28 million in capital and quickly became a pioneer in computational finance. In the early days of exposed pipes and extension cords, tripping on a cable could take out our whole trading system. Today, the firm has more than 3,000 people around the globe and an institutional-grade (and trip-proof) infrastructure, but we still value creativity, entrepreneurship, and the spirit of discovery.If you’re an intellectually adventurous person who loves to collaborate on challenging and rewarding projects, we encourage you to apply. past.employee_description: Compliance development team works toward achieving automation for most of the possible piece of task for the Firm's Compliance team. It constitutes not just one of the major decisions making part in the day to day trading activity of the Firm, but also ensuring compliance with various regulatory laws imposed by regulators globally. The development team is responsible for providing Compliance users a real-time platform for monitoring, surveillance and historical analysis. My projects majorly include Compliance Platform, insider trading surveillance, anti-money laundering check, best execution, restriction reporting for IAM trading, Position Limits monitoring and swap reporting – dodd-frank act.

basic_info.description: Trendlyne is a ‘Retail Bloomberg platform’ enabling decision making for retail investors, research analysts and Portfolio advisors with real time data analytics. Our technology turns every financial data point into structured data, on which strategies can be created and back tested in real time. Trendlyne DVM scores provide a headline insight on how good or bad a stock is - simplifying investment decision making.Our AI, MarketMind is the most accurate, cost effective AI in the stock market.Trendlyne provides retail investors, analysts and advisors with easy to use analytics tools. Trendlyne provides screener tools with over 700 metrics, backtesting, portfolio NAV calculation and more. Our screener and backtesting tools combine fundamental, technical, shareholding, analyst indicators and more with unprecedented flexibility, with backtest capabilities that are available for the first time across markets. Visit us at https://trendlyne.comMarketMind:  https://trendlyne.com/marketmind/ask-ai/

past.employer_linkedin_description: Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R&D. We design and manufacture high-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading-edge telecom products for building end-to-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 1,000,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99.999%.Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution.As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.
